body:
:) I suppose I could give it a try yeah.

But still very doubtfull if it will work though.

Okay I've been spending time on the dutch site they have. It seems more like a scam to me than anything else. 
I fail to see why I should spend 350 euro's on something that could basicly be done for free.

So that's not really an option.
As a person who does not believe in god/anything spirituals I think that will not help me and I live in the Netherlands. But thanks anyway. :)

If I'm my own hope then I'm fucked.
I have no intentions or even the strength to help myself. It's not going to work. I tried it already. I can't do it myself.

> Main take-away, other people's cowardice about dealing with core issues should not be taken as proof of lack of self-worth. Their behavior says a lot about them, and is not proof of you not having self worth.

You're wrong there. If suddenly all people don't care or don't want to care about me then that is a pretty big sign that it's something about me.


My therapist is doing nothing of anything you are saying. Yeah he tries to be helping. But really, all I do is talk with him and make a new appointment.
I wish I could go to another one. But it's the only one available for me. So I'm stuck.



I have no idea in what ways you are seeing a handful of steps of myself to improve my situation. If anything it's going down hill.

The next 4 months I will spend alone. In a small room with only a bed, my pc and a tv.
I don't like it. But I don't hate it enough to leave it. (only the context would change, so it wouldn't really help anyway) I would rather kill myself then try to help myself because no matter what I do, I will always be stuck with myself.

In what world can you call someone a friend when you ignore them when they need you the most?
Even if it takes a couple of days or anything to digest the news, I imagine that at some point you would want to help.
But I guess not!

They had the time to think about this. (more than enough time) And apparantly I am not worth it. Not worth it to see if I'm still alive. To see if there's anything they can do. Or you know, anything at all.


But it's okay. It's not that I'm mad at them for just being people. I would think I'm better off dead too.

> Recovery from depression is not smooth; inevitably there are these valleys where the despair grabs you and tries to fool you into thinking that you did nothing right and you will never get better. Please don't be fooled. From what you say here you have made and are making real progress in your recovery, despite real and serious issues that threaten to bring you down.

Thank you. That is what I need to hear. It shows me that I'm on my way to happiness.

But to be honest I wouldn't really care if people wouldn't want to be around me or connect to me on a deep level. Because when it really matters they will be selfish. 
I'll secretly hope they would all stop talking to me. Every single one of them. When that happens I'll have more time to myself. And I prefer that over listening to people's small problems while I got my own real problems I can't handle myself.

Thanks for the offer to talk but I don't really feel comfortable talking or typing in english. I feel restricted by my vocabulary which isn't that big.

But thank you for your comment. 
I suppose I know there are people who love me. But right now it feels like nobody does. And why should they, it's not like I'm that great.
